PENDING: Get `analysis.json` accepted by `submit.sh`; resolve the validator’s `propagation[1]` schema complaint; if accepted, finish interaction.

CURRENT_STATE: `/workspace/analysis.json` currently contains a candidate artifact with `sample_id` `secbench_oss_libxml2.ossfuzz-42486772`; latest candidate uses trace anchors around `xmlreader.c:1579/1585/1594` and `xinclude.c:294/25`; submission still rejected with `propagation[1] must contain from,to,type,via and optional relation`.

CODE_STATE: Relevant files remain `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/xmlreader.c`, `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/xinclude.c`, `/workspace/analysis.json`; key functions: `xmlTextReaderRead(...)`, `xmlXIncludeProcessNode(...)`, `xmlXIncludeDoProcess(...)`, `xmlXIncludeIncludeNode(...)`.

TESTS: Local JSON parse checks passed; `submit.sh` consistently rejects the artifact with `propagation[1] must contain from,to,type,via and optional relation`; no successful benchmark verdict.

CHANGES: Edited `/workspace/analysis.json` many times; latest version includes a 4-entry `propagation` array and `fine_trace` entries for the suspected source/intermediate/root/sink path.

DEPS: No dependency changes; only local benchmark scripts and libxml2 source tree used.
